mentions.claim_text: He says God is not done with America and that the point is the wealth of the sinner laid up for the righteous through an end time wealth transfer for the body of Christ, with a great assignment attached.
mentions.quote: the wealth of the sinner laid up for the righteous
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as given: no recipients, amounts or dates.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told they are running out of time and that a major war is about to break out, distinguishing it from wars and rumours of wars as a potential major world war.
mentions.quote: you're running out of time. A major war is about to break out
mentions.falsify_match: A general war involving major powers.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. About to has no date, and the distinction he draws from rumours of war is not given a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He explains that he was told to pray in English because it translates better for the channels in Asia, and greets Asian viewers.
mentions.quote: it translates better for the other channels in Asia
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a note about broadcast practice.

mentions.claim_text: He uses Willy Wonka to contrast a boy whose heart was pure and gave the sweet back with a girl whose attitude was that everything was owed to her, and says this is what the Lord kept showing him.
mentions.quote: the little girl had an attitude of it's all owed to me
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an illustration about entitlement, drawn from a film.

mentions.claim_text: He says war is rice paper thin concerning Zelenskyy, Putin and Europe, and could escalate beyond anything seen in this generation unless they intercede for hearts to change that night.
mentions.quote: war is rice paper thin concerning Zalinski, Putin
mentions.falsify_match: Escalation in Europe beyond anything in this generation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The prayer condition means a quiet outcome reads as answered rather than wrong.

mentions.claim_text: He says a dividing line will show at the UN with the sheep and goat nations becoming very prominent, and that there will be great earthquakes like none seen before.
mentions.quote: the sheep and the goat nations will be very, very prominent
mentions.falsify_match: A formal split of nations at the UN over Israel, and record earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Undated, though record earthquakes would be measurable against USGS records.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being shown Asian people across China and Vietnam, and people in Africa and South America, and being told to keep doing what he is doing because revival is coming to them.
mentions.quote: revival in my with my Asian people
mentions.falsify_match: Revival across Asia, Africa and South America.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees New York and Times Square, and a great revival in Times Square.
mentions.quote: A great revival in Time Square
mentions.falsify_match: A large religious revival meeting held in Times Square.
mentions.falsify_miss: None held. A named place, which makes it checkable if it happens.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees two states highlighted, Tennessee and Kentucky, with nothing further attached.
mentions.quote: I see these two states highlighted Tennessee and Kentucky
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: two state names with nothing attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is revival and it will be beautiful, and that people will come to these places by the tens of thousands if not hundreds of thousands because they are hungry.
mentions.quote: by the tens of thousands, if not hundreds of thousands
mentions.falsify_match: Meetings drawing tens or hundreds of thousands, which is countable.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing on that scale. The numbers are the useful part: attendance is published.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing Trump crack the whip toward the bear and toward the dragon so that they bowed for a season, followed by great favour like Jonathan and David.
mentions.quote: He cracked the whip towards the bear. He cracked the whip towards the dragon
mentions.falsify_match: Russia and China both yielding to American pressure for a period.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither yields. For a season sets no length.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to billions of dollars of oil in the Mediterranean outside Gaza and says the meeting is not the problem.
mentions.quote: of dollars of oil in the Mediterranean outside the Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: Offshore hydrocarbon wealth off Gaza becoming a driver of the conflict. The Gaza Marine gas field is real and its development has been discussed publicly for two decades.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Note the resource there is gas rather than oil.

mentions.claim_text: He says Zelenskyy is a Pinocchio again and that in the days ahead he will be more so, lying a lot, describing him as a marionette and a puppet to others behind a deep state darkness.
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a character judgment on a named head of state with no test attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a strengthening of an alliance involving Kim beyond its current level, and that Iran is picking up the pieces with trouble within it.
mentions.quote: I see a strengthening of an alliance, Kim, even more so
mentions.falsify_match: The Russia-North Korea alliance deepening further, with internal instability in Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The alliance was already deepening publicly, with North Korean troops in Russia reported from late 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He prays against a major war, declaring it defused and that their sons and daughters will not fight in it and there will not be a major uprising.
mentions.quote: our sons and daughters will not fight in this
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition against the war he has just described.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim. Note the structure: he has forecast the war and is now declaring it will not happen, so either outcome confirms something he has said.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees New York again with buildings on fire and an uprising there, and invokes David Wilkerson.
mentions.quote: I saw the buildings on fire. I saw an uprising in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Riots with buildings burning in New York City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Wilkerson's 1973 vision of New York burning is the source of the image, which he names himself.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects himself from Latinos to South America and calls revival over South America from sea to sea and over the Latino community.
mentions.quote: we call forth revival in South America

mentions.claim_text: He calls revival over the Latino community, over Asia, South Korea, Japan, China and Vietnam.
mentions.quote: we speak revival in the name of Jesus all over South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition naming countries.
